programme.title: La Fille du Président
programme.desc: La fille du Président des Etats-Unis insiste pour suivre une scolarité normale, sans la surveillance des services secrets. Un agent se fait donc passer pour un étudiant afin de la protéger.

programme.title: She's so lovely
programme.desc: Après avoir été libéré d'une institution psychiatrique, un homme tente de se racheter aux yeux de son ex-femme des événements qui ont conduit à son incarcération.

programme.title: For Love or Money
programme.desc: Mark a une vie de rêve : il est sur le point de devenir multimillionnaire et d'épouser son amour de jeunesse, Connie. Mais les choses ne sont parfaites qu'en surface : Mark découvre par hasard que Connie ne l'aime pas et compte juste voler sa fortune une fois le mariage prononcé.

programme.title: Amour Aveugle
programme.desc: Un romancier new-yorkais est rendu aveugle par un accident de voiture qui tue sa femme. Des années plus tard, il retrouve l'envie de vivre et d'écrire lorsqu'il commence une aventure avec une femme négligée par son mari, un homme d'affaires.

programme.title: La liberté à tout prix
programme.desc: Allemagne de l'Est 1984 : Frank Korbach se réjouit de fréquenter l'école d'art dramatique tandis que son meilleur ami rebelle Thomas refuse de faire son service militaire. Avec l'aventureux mais naïf Alex Thomas projette de faire une tentative désespérée de fuite vers l'Ouest. Sachant qu'il ne les reverra peut-être jamais Frank accompagne Thomas et Alex à la frontière. Soudain ils sont confrontés à une unité spéciale de la Stasi la police secrète est-allemande. Bien que les garçons parviennent à éviter la capture l'ancienne vie de Frank a disparu à jamais - il est maintenant devenu un fugitif. Le père de Frank Kurt Korbach est stupéfait par cette évasion. Kurt est un major de la Stasi à l'insu de son fils. Convaincu que Frank est innocent il persuade ses supérieurs que lui seul peut ramener son fils. Avec le suspect colonel Frey - une bombe à retardement prête à exploser - Kurt se met en route pour retrouver les garçons en fuite.

programme.title: La montagne du silence
programme.desc: Les deux amies Johanna et Marlies sont spécialisées dans la conception de campagnes de marketing au sein de l'Association autrichienne du tourisme. Lorsqu'on a demandé à Johanna de commercialiser une région montagneuse isolée de Styrie en tant que nouvelle destination de plaisir son enthousiasme était limité. La citadine invétérée ne peut rien faire avec les montagnes les fermes et les cloches qui sonnent. Son amie et collègue Marlies en revanche aime les montagnes par-dessus tout et est donc en feu lorsqu'elle se voit attribuer le contrat pour le projet sur la recommandation de Johanna. Elle parvient même à convaincre l'alpiniste de renommée mondiale Ferdinand Plocher de participer à la campagne - et elle s'intéresse aussi personnellement à ce charmant homme de plein air. Tout semble être parfait : Johanna peut rester à Vienne pendant que les Marlies pleines de vie se baladent dans les montagnes pour faire des recherches. Jusqu'à ce que Johanna reçoive la nouvelle choquante de la mort de son ami. Stupéfaite et accablée par un profond sentiment de culpabilité elle se rend en Styrie pour ramener le corps de Marlies à la maison. Elle y retrouve Ferdinand qui avait flirté sans retenue avec elle lors de sa visite à Vienne mais qui se retrouve soudain à l'écart. Comme Marlies auparavant Johanna loue une chambre d'hôte sur l'Almhof au frère de Ferdinand Jörg un solitaire amer qui doit s'occuper seul de sa fille malade Veverl. Les querelles constantes entre les frères différents rendent Johanna méfiante. D'autres éléments indiquent également que l'accident d'escalade de Marlies s'est produit différemment de ce qui avait été annoncé. Bien qu'elle rencontre un mur de silence parmi les villageois elle continue à faire des recherches inlassables. Et même si Ferdinand ne l'aide pas vraiment les deux se rapprochent émotionnellement. Plus Johanna passe de temps avec l'alpiniste passionné plus elle apprend à apprécier les montagnes majestueuses et impressionnantes. Elle commence alors à tomber amoureuse de l'homme qui semble le mieux connaître les véritables circonstances de la mort de son amie.

programme.title: Flirt et Passe-Passe
programme.desc: Des jumelles identiques, Alice et Lacey, sont prises l'une pour l'autre lors d'une retraite. Elles décident de jouer le jeu le temps du séjour, mais réalisent bientôt qu'elles se sont peut-être trompées sur ce dont elles avaient réellement besoin dans leur vie.

programme.title: De l'Italie avec Amore
programme.desc: Ariel Moss aperçoit ce qu'elle pense être l'homme de ses rêves dans un restaurant local. Dans sa quête pour le revoir, elle rencontre Daniel, un séduisant restaurateur, qui l'aide à comprendre que le chemin vers son cœur passe peut-être par son estomac.

programme.title: Une Pluie sans Fin
programme.desc: Un homme licencié d'une aciérie veut désespérément traquer un tueur en série dans une petite ville du sud de la Chine.

programme.title: Macbeth
programme.desc: Les bas-fonds de Melbourne, dans un futur proche. Macbeth est le bras droit de Duncan, le parrain local.

programme.title: Deadly Past
programme.desc: Un barman se réconcilie avec son ex-petite amie avant de découvrir qu'il fait partie d'un stratagème criminel.

programme.title: Charlie Says
programme.desc: Le film traite de charles manson, et en particulier l'influence qu'il a eu sur une jeune femme de 19 ans.

programme.title: Macbeth
programme.desc: Les bas-fonds de Melbourne, dans un futur proche. Macbeth est le bras droit de Duncan, le parrain local.

programme.title: Noël avec ma fille
programme.desc: Deux parents célibataires entrevoient la possibilité d'un Noël romantique, mais découvrent que leurs filles sont en proie à une rivalité féroce à l'école. Lorsque cette rivalité dégénère, l'espoir et la réconciliation pourront-ils mener chacun à un Noël paisible et joyeux ?

programme.title: Coup de foudre sous les flocons
programme.desc: Une photographe en quête d'un rare flocon de neige à douze côtés embarque avec une amie d'enfance dans une aventure hivernale qui pourrait transformer leur vie.

programme.title: Un Noël créatif
programme.desc: Harper, illustratrice en herbe, aide un auteur célèbre mais en panne d'inspiration dans une petite ville du Colorado pendant Noël. Entre créativité et festivités, une romance inattendue naît peu à peu.

programme.title: La plus belle étoile de Noël
programme.desc: De retour dans sa ville pour Noël, Vanessa, médecin dévouée, hésite entre une promotion prestigieuse et la clinique familiale. Entre ancienne romance et attachement à sa communauté, son cœur balance.

programme.title: Un amour de photographe
programme.desc: Laura, assistante de galerie passionnée de photo, doit convaincre Shane, un artiste retiré du monde depuis dix ans, d'exposer ses clichés. En l'aidant à retrouver l'inspiration, elle pourrait aussi trouver sa propre voie.

programme.title: Still Crazy
programme.desc: Wisbech 1977. Strange Fruit, le groupe de rock britannique, jette ses derniers feux. Entre les chamailleries mesquines et les coups bas en coulisses et sur scene, le groupe se dissout. Ibiza 1997. Tony, l'ancien clavier, reconverti en fournisseur de preservatifs sur l'ile, rencontre par hasard le fils du promoteur de Wisbech qui lui propose de reformer le groupe pour un concert, Wisbech 1998.

programme.title: Faut S'faire La Malle
programme.desc: Un des films contemporains les plus fous ! STIR CRAZY rassemble deux des comédiens les plus brillants et déjantés d'aujourd'hui : Richard Pryor et Gene Wilder. Skip (Wilder) et Harry (Pryor) ont tous les deux été renvoyés de leur travail. Ils s'embarquent donc vers la Californie pour trouver fortune et célébrité, mais sur le chemin, leur van tombe en panne. Mais ils sont fauchés et il faut bien manger. Ils se font donc embaucher comme piverts chantants et dansants pour faire la publicité de l'ouverture d'une banque. Lorsque deux voyous volent leur déguisement et cambriolent la banque, devinez vers qui on se tourne... Skip et Harry sont donc envoyés en prison pour 125 ans. Ils essaient de rester sains d'esprit et en vie, mais ce n'est pas simple avec un gardien sadique, un meurtrier au physique imposant et un rodéo inter-prisons...

programme.title: Premiers Pas Dans La Mafia
programme.desc: A peine arrivé à New York, Clark Kellogg, jeune étudiant en cinéma, se fait détrousser par un faux chauffeur de taxi. Mais cet incident l'amène à rencontrer Carmine Sabatini, mafieux sosie du Parrain, qui lui confie une mission insolite : transporter un mystérieux colis destiné à une assemblée secrète de gourmets...

programme.title: Profession : Génie
programme.desc: Quand trois jeunes surdoués, aussi saugrenus que talentueux, associent leurs talents, on peut s'attendre au meilleur comme au pire. Censés travailler sur un projet scientifique, ils découvrent qu'ils développent, sans le savoir, une arme secrète pour l'armée. Ils échafaudent alors un plan ingénieux pour se venger de leur mentor, le Professeur Hathaway, un homme sans scrupule. Ils vont se montrer plus futés que l'armée et montrer au Professeur qu'il ne faut pas se moquer des véritables génies !

programme.title: Art School Confidential
programme.desc: Passionné par le dessin depuis son enfance, le jeune Jérome s'inscrit dans une école d'art, à Strathmore. Alors qu'il apprend peu à peu comment fonctionne le monde des artistes, un tueur en série va semer la panique au sein de l'établissement.

programme.title: Un Anglais à New York
programme.desc: Quand Sidney Young, chroniqueur dans un obscur journal anglais, est engagé par Sharps, LE magazine hype new-yorkais, il jubile, persuadé que sa place dans les soirées les plus select de Manhattan est assuré ...

programme.title: Simplement irrésistible
programme.desc: Un cadre d'un grand magasin essaye de ne pas tomber amoureux d'une jeune femme qui, selon lui, acquiert des pouvoirs magiques depuis qu'elle a hérité d'un restaurant.

programme.title: Frangins Malgré Eux
programme.desc: A 39 ans, Brennan Huff n'a toujours pas de vrai boulot et vit chez sa mère Nancy. Dale Doback est un éternel chômeur de 40 ans qui vit chez son père Robert.

programme.title: Le Retour de Sabata
programme.desc: Les citoyens de Hobsonville engagent Sabata pour les débarrasser du clan McIntock, qui les taxe de force et illégalement sous le prétexte du développement de la ville.

programme.title: Adios Caballero
programme.desc: Stan Ross, un justicier à lunettes, arrive à Canyon City et se retrouve pris dans un conflit opposant deux factions rivales.

programme.title: Sept colts du tonnerre
programme.desc: Timothy Benson, un jeune intellectuel inexpérimenté, hérite d'une mine d'or. Rodrigo Rodriguez, un chef de bandits, est prêt à tout pour que Timothy lui cède la mine.

programme.title: Gentleman Killer
programme.desc: Une ville frontalière devient l'objet de troubles politiques entre les États-Unis et le Mexique lorsqu'un bandit commence à tuer autant de soldats américains qu'il le peut.

programme.title: 4 balles pour Joë
programme.desc: La mort mystérieuse d'un homme qui s'apprête à quitter une petite ville du Kansas avec sa petite amie déclenche une série d'événements malheureux.

programme.title: Le retour de Billy the Kid
programme.desc: Rogers joue le rôle d'un sosie du défunt Billy The Kid et rétablit la tranquillité du comté de Lincoln après avoir maîtrisé les éléments criminels. Un bon divertissement.

programme.title: La Charge des Cosaques
programme.desc: L'histoire de Hadji Murad, un chef tchétchène du XIXe siècle qui a mené ses guerriers dans un combat contre les forces envahissantes du tsar russe.

programme.title: On continue à l'appeller Trinita
programme.desc: Bambino essaie d'apprendre à son frère Trinity comment devenir un hors-la-loi, mais ils finissent par sauver une famille de pionniers et à défaire un réseau de contrebande.

programme.title: Buckaroo ne pardonne pas
programme.desc: Dans l'Ouest sauvage, Buckaroo, un mystérieux pistolero, arrive dans une ville minée par la corruption et la violence. Engagé malgré lui dans un conflit entre un puissant propriétaire terrien et un groupe de fermiers opprimés, il décide de prendre les armes pour rétablir la justice. Entre duels impitoyables, trahisons et quête de vengeance, Buckaroo devra affronter son propre passé pour faire triompher la loi du plus fort… ou celle du plus juste.

programme.title: Last survivors
programme.desc: Au lendemain d'un événement apocalyptique qui a contraint les gens à un isolement extrême. Un père et son fils rencontrent une étrangère qui menace de détruire l'utopie qu'ils ont construite.

programme.title: Zombeavers
programme.desc: Un groupe d'adolescents en vacances au bord d'une rivière se retrouve menacé par une horde de castors zombies. Le weekend de débauche va rapidement tourner à la catastrophe pour les jeunes.

programme.title: Witchville
programme.desc: Lorsqu'il apprend que son père est mort, le noble Prince Malachy retourne à Draeganoth pour éliminer une assemblée de sorcière menée par la puissante Reine Rouge qui sème la destruction dans le royaume.

programme.title: Curvature
programme.desc: Après le suicide de son mari Wells, Helen découvre que son passé cachait bien des secrets. Lors d'une étrange panne de courant, elle se réveille chez elle et reçoit un appel d'elle-même l'avertissant qu'un homme vient pour la tuer.

programme.title: Le Chemin du Passé
programme.desc: Un scientifique disparaît mystérieusement lors d'un déplacement professionnel. Une nouvelle dévastatrice pour son épouse et son fils. Plusieurs années après, son fils et son grand-père font une étonnante découverte au sujet de cette disparition.

programme.title: Alien Uprising
programme.desc: Sur une planète carcérale, Marines et prisonniers doivent s'unir pour survivre à une créature extraterrestre.

programme.title: Les Prédateurs: D'une femme à l'autre
programme.desc: Menacé d'expulsion, un immigré accepte un mariage blanc et découvre que son épouse change de personnalité chaque semaine.

programme.title: Robocop: L'argent ne fait pas le bonheur
programme.desc: Robocop traque un voleur d'organe après le vol du cœur destiné à sauver un enfant malade.

programme.title: Farscape: Jeremiah Crichton
programme.desc: Abandonné sur une planète primitive, Crichton devient une figure quasi divine avant que son retour ne bouleverse l'équilibre.

programme.title: Invasion Planète Terre: Le secret de Strandhill
programme.desc: Un guide irlandais découvre la possible tombe de Ma'el, dont les recherches sont cruciales pour les Taelons.

programme.title: Robocop: L'argent ne fait pas le bonheur
programme.desc: Robocop traque un voleur d'organe après le vol du cœur destiné à sauver un enfant malade.

programme.title: The Outpost: Qui prendra le pouvoir ?
programme.desc: Garret veut voir Talon monter sur le trône, tandis qu'un assassin cherche vengeance et que Falista prépare un nouveau plan.

programme.title: Snowmageddon
programme.desc: Une boule à neige mystique déclenche de vraies catastrophes et menace une ville d'Alaska.

programme.title: Abandonnée
programme.desc: Marie hérite en Russie et découvre un double d'elle-même aux yeux vitreux.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Northmen
programme.desc: Des femmes en quête de vengeance affrontent des Vikings et une armée de démons dans un monastère.

programme.title: La Légende des Mondes
programme.desc: Dans une contrée aujourd'hui disparue, les derniers des Hobbits vivent dans un petit village.

programme.title: Oro: La Cité Perdue
programme.desc: 1538, au cœur de l'Amazonie sauvage, un groupe de conquistadors espagnols part à la recherche d'une mythique cité d'or : Teziutlan. Aveuglés par leur quête et leur soif de richesse, ils plongent au plus profond de l'enfer vert, jusqu'à en perdre la raison.

programme.title: The Rage
programme.desc: Une épidémie de rage se déclare dans la taïga russe.

programme.title: War Of Apes
programme.desc: Pour sauver l'humanité, un gigantesque singe et son ennemi mécanique, Mecha Ape MkII, s'allient.

programme.title: Megaboa
programme.desc: Un groupe d'étudiants se rend dans la forêt tropicale à la recherche de dessins rupestres. Mais un boa constricteur de quinze mètres que l'on croyait éteint a faim de sang.

programme.title: Baba Yaga : La Forêt des Damnés
programme.desc: Une nounou séduisante trouble Egor, qui doute bientôt de sa véritable identité.

programme.title: Les Dieux des Profondeurs
programme.desc: Lorsqu'une équipe de sous-marins entre dans une ouverture mystérieuse au fond de l'océan, ils découvrent un monde sous-marin perdu et réveillent un ancien peuple venu d'un autre monde.

programme.title: Mon mari assassiné
programme.desc: Samson espionne sa voisine qui a une liaison et après le meurtre de son mari, il devient suspect.

programme.title: Cortex
programme.desc: Hagen paranoïaque, imagine que sa femme Karoline le trompe. Mais un jour son épouse a une aventure.

programme.title: CHAPPAQUIDDICK, Le Secret des Kennedy
programme.desc: Un sénateur est impliqué dans l'accident de voiture mortel de l'ex directrice de campagne de Kennedy.

programme.title: Avventura
programme.desc: Francesca retourne dans sa ville natale où elle retrouve son ex-petit ami.

programme.title: Le Combattant
programme.desc: Jem Belcher est né dans la pauvreté, élevé par son grand-père, un ancien boxeur. Désespérant de gagner sa vie et d'honorer l'héritage de son grand-père, il cherche un mentor auprès d'un entraîneur renommé, qui l'entraîne à devenir le plus grand combattant du monde. Inspiré d'une histoire vraie.

programme.title: Street Kings
programme.desc: Lorsque des preuves impliquent un policier vétéran du LAPD dans l'exécution d'un collègue, il est obligé de s'opposer à la culture policière dont il a fait partie pendant toute sa carrière.

programme.title: Une virée en enfer
programme.desc: Deux frères embarqués dans un voyage à travers le pays utilisent leur radio CB pour faire une blague à un camionneur dérangé qui se transforme en harceleur meurtrier vengeur.

programme.title: Père et fille
programme.desc: Fathers and Daughters raconte l'histoire d'un père et de sa fille vivant à New York. Le récit alterne entre les années 1980, où Jake Davis (Russell Crowe), un romancier veuf gagnant d'un Pulitzer, lutte contre la maladie mentale alors qu'il tente d'élever sa fille de 5 ans Katie (Amanda Seyfried)...

programme.title: Bloody Hell
programme.desc: Un homme au passé mystérieux fuit le pays pour échapper à son propre enfer personnel.

programme.title: The Canyons
programme.desc: Christian dérape quand il apprend que sa femme le trompe avec le héro du film qu'il produit.

programme.title: La Prophétie des ombres
programme.desc: Un reporter est dans une petite ville de Virginie pour enquêter sur une série d'événements étranges.

programme.title: Born bad
programme.desc: Une jeune fille tombe amoureuse d'un vagabond mais ne se doute pas que c'est un psychopathe.

programme.title: King of Killers
programme.desc: Marcus Garan, ex-tueur à gages, accepte un contrat de 10 millions de dollars pour éliminer le plus redoutable assassin du monde. Arrivé à Tokyo, il découvre qu'il n'est pas seul : d'autres tueurs sont en lice. Tous entrent alors dans une traque mortelle où chacun peut devenir la cible.

programme.title: Darkland Undercover
programme.desc: Emprisonné depuis sept ans, Zaid accepte de se mettre au service de la police en échange de sa libération. Il va devoir infiltrer un gang violent pour espérer sortir un jour de prison et revoir son fils Noah.

programme.title: Bus 657
programme.desc: Luke Vaughn (Jeffrey Dean Morgan), un père désespéré, braque le casino du chef de la mafia Pope Silva (Robert De Niro) pour sauver sa fille malade. Le braquage tourne mal, obligeant Vaughn et son équipe à détourner un bus pour s'échapper.

programme.title: Rendel : le cycle de vengeance
programme.desc: Après le meurtre de sa famille, Rendel s'est juré de les venger et de détruire les responsables : l'organisation VALA. Leur nouveau et impitoyable leader, Christopher 'Smiley' Cox, est sur le point de diffuser un vaccin NH25 nocif dans le monde entier.

programme.title: Cagefighter
programme.desc: Champion incontesté des LEGENDS, Reiss doit affronter une star du catch dans le combat le plus risqué et imprévisible de sa carrière.

programme.title: Permis de tuer
programme.desc: Harmon et son équipe doivent empêcher une alliance entre terroristes et cartel mexicain de faire entrer des armes de destruction massive aux États-Unis.

programme.title: Pensacola Wings of God
programme.desc: Lors d'un vol d'entraînement, Breaker subit une panne mécanique et perd le contrôle de son appareil à l'atterrissage.

programme.title: Pensacola Wings of God
programme.desc: Bill Kelly et Hammer partent en mission secrète dans le golfe Persique pour détruire le réacteur nucléaire Osirak.

programme.title: Chokehold
programme.desc: Pour venger son père, une femme infiltre le monde brutal du MMA et traque la mafia russe responsable de sa mort.

programme.title: Pensacola Wings of God
programme.desc: Après un vol brillant, Burner franchit le mur du son près de Pensacola et provoque un énorme incident sur la base.

programme.title: The Invitation
programme.desc: Par une sombre nuit, Will est invité à un dîner chez son ex-femme et son nouveau mari. Au cours de la soirée, il s'aperçoit que ses hôtes ont d'inquiétantes intentions envers leurs invités.

programme.title: Hundreds of Beavers
programme.desc: XIXe siècle. Fabricant et consommateur d'Applejack, Jean Kayak se retrouve ruiné après la destruction de sa ferme par des castors. Il devient alors le plus grand chasseur de fourrure d'Amérique du Nord.

programme.title: Hitcher
programme.desc: Jim Halsey accepte de convoyer une voiture à travers les États-Unis pour s'éviter des frais de voyage onéreux. Par une nuit pluvieuse il prend en auto-stop un dénommé John Ryder, un personnage étrange et inquiétant. Jim comprend très rapidement qu'il a affaire à un tueur psychopathe...

programme.title: L'Exorcisme de Tamara
programme.desc: Un cambriolage tourne à l'horreur dans une maison.

programme.title: The Other Side
programme.desc: Shirin s'installe avec son beau-fils Lucas, hanté par une présence maléfique dans la maison voisine.

programme.title: Impuratus
programme.desc: L'inspecteur Clayton Douglas enquête sur une affaire dans un asile isolé.

programme.title: Ghosts of the Abyss
programme.desc: Rachel, une chercheuse inquiète, et son équipe ont pris la mer pour prouver que la disparition d'une famille et de l'équipage d'un navire marchand était due à des raisons ayant trait au surnaturel.

programme.title: Apocalypse of Ice
programme.desc: En pleine pandémie mondiale, un vortex menace de recouvrir la Terre de glace

programme.title: 7 Secondes
programme.desc: Le Capitaine Jack Tolliver, ancien membre du commando Delta Force, commet un vol de voiture qui aurait dû marcher comme sur des roulettes. Mais il se retrouve avec une toile de Van Gogh inestimable, et l'un des membres de son équipe est pris en otage par des gangsters russes sadiques qui sont intervenus dans le hold-up.

programme.title: L'Affaire Roman J.
programme.desc: Avec la mort de son mentor, Roman J. Israel (Denzel Washington), avocat aussi idéaliste que déterminé, voit sa vie bouleversée. Recruté par l'ambitieux George Pierce (Colin Farrell), Roman se lie d'amitié avec une militante de l'égalité des droits (Carmen Ejogo). Confronté à des événements extrêmes, il va pourtant être obligé de remettre en question l'engagement qui a déterminé toute sa carrière…

programme.title: Vol D'enfer
programme.desc: Après avoir déserté, John Sands, un ancien agent secret de l'US Air Force, se voit contraint d'accepter une dernière mission : retrouver un avion de combat furtif qui a été détourné par une armée rebelle…

programme.title: Wind Chill
programme.desc: Deux étudiants partagent une voiture pour rentrer chez eux pour les vacances. Ils tombent en panne sur une route déserte et deviennent la proie des fantômes de tous ceux qui sont morts à cet endroit.

programme.title: Souviens Toi L'ete Dernier
programme.desc: La nuit de la fête nationale, Julie, Helen, Ray et Barry ont par accident renversé un inconnu. Devant la crainte de leur avenir compromis par ce drame, ils décident de faire disparaître le corps et font le serment de ne rien dire à personne, jamais. L'été suivant, chacun des quatre amis se trouve confronté à des évenements terrifiants. Ils doivent se rendre à l'évidence : quelqu'un sait ce qu'ils ont fait et semble bien decidé à le leur faire payer.

programme.title: The Aviary
programme.desc: Deux femmes s'enfuient dans le désert pour échapper aux griffes d'un culte insidieux

programme.title: Battlestar Rebellion
programme.desc: Un cosmonaute découvre une planète régie par les Pères Inconnus, cinq gouverneurs anonymes dictateurs..

programme.title: Box Office Action
programme.desc: Découvrez les bandes annonces des films à l'affiche sur les chaînes Box Office

programme.title: Arthur et Merlin
programme.desc: Arthur, un guerrier banni, et Merlin, un sorcier ermite, s'unissent pour sauver le peuple celte.

programme.title: Italian Race
programme.desc: Jeune pilote prometteuse, son seul espoir est son frère, ancien champion de rallye devenu drogué.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled
programme.desc: Jonathan explores bustling Delhi and seeks out higher ground in the mountain town of Manali, embarking on a motorcycle adventure to the highest roads in the world

programme.title: Eaten By Lions
programme.desc: A hilarious and heart-warming story of half brothers Omar and Pete, who embark on a journey from Bradford to Blackpool to find Omar's real Dad.

programme.title: Fully Torqued
programme.desc: Steve has an old Thunderbird that he'd like to fix up and sell, donating the proceeds to a charity that is near and dear to his heart.

programme.title: Fully Torqued
programme.desc: Herb Dean, one of the best MMA referees in the business, has an old Bronco that he wants to get fixed up so he can take his wife on romantic trips up the coast.

programme.title: Poldark

programme.title: Julian Clary On Easing Anxiety
programme.desc: Can laughter ease anxiety? Comedian Julian Clary certainly thinks so. After living some incredibly dark events and anxious times, he's decided to choose to laugh and think positive thoughts. In this chat with Fearne, Julian talks about feeling naturally happier and more comfortable in his skin as he got older. Most things, he says, just aren't as important as you think they are, and that's a freeing realisation.

programme.title: Louise Redknapp On Coping With Loneliness And Low Self-Esteem
programme.desc: Singer Louise Redknapp discusses feeling pressure to be the 'good girl' after years in a 90s girlband and marriage to a sports star, which left her afraid of saying or doing the wrong thing. She explores how not knowing her dad and becoming a mother have impacted her confidence and identity, and shares how she's learning to trust her own gut instinct and embrace different facets of her character.

programme.title: Kate Winslet: Why I'm Embracing Wrinkles And Championing Women
programme.desc: Grief can make you feel unnervingly vulnerable this is how Kate Winslet reflects on losing her mum in 2017. In this chat, Fearne and Kate share their own experiences of both grieving and co-parenting at Christmas. Regularly labelled as "fat" by the media, Kate explains what effect that scrutiny had on her self-esteem, and why it's made her even more passionate about setting an example to younger women by ageing naturally.

programme.title: Jesy Nelson On Finding Herself And Feeling Free After Leaving Little Mix
programme.desc: As part of Little Mix, Jesy Nelson felt constantly compared to her bandmates and struggled with the pressure of being in a girl band, leading to self-esteem problems and depression. She discusses with Fearne how appearance mattered as much as talent in the music industry.

programme.title: Brian Cox On Finding Purpose In A Vast Universe
programme.desc: What can the universe teach us about being human? Physicist Professor Brian Cox discusses getting comfortable with being wrong, the difference between having an argument and making an argument, and how curiosity and doubt are essential to learning and happiness. He explores why ego blocks human progress, how democracy depends on doubt, the beauty of curiosity, the randomness of life, and our greatest moral responsibility in protecting the planet.

programme.title: Leah Williamson On Bouncing Back From A Footballer's Worst Nightmare
programme.desc: Footballer Leah Williamson discusses how getting through a major injury has made her love the person she is now more than the one she was before because of the way she looks after herself. Leah talks about the importance of listening to your own body, and trusting what it's trying to tell you rather than ignoring or overriding it.

programme.title: How Coleen And Wayne Rooney Make Their Marriage Work
programme.desc: Coleen Rooney discusses how she and husband Wayne prioritise honesty, family and their relationship after many years together. She explains how she's instilling honesty in her four sons and the importance of having a village to help raise her boys. Coleen also discusses school gate WhatsApp group dynamics, dealing with stress, and what it was like being thrust into the public eye as a teenager when her boyfriend became a footballer.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: A King and His Queen
programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

programme.title: Lake Magic
programme.desc: Mini land-bound oceans, lakes are a treasure trove of aquatic wonders. Lakes make up just 3% of the Earth's surface, but they hold 180,000 square kilometres of fresh water. From the shoreline to their depths are unique habitats teaming with life, home to everything from birds and bugs to frogs and fish. They can be anything from sanctuary from land predators and temperature regulators to bountiful food sources and pit-stops for migrating birdlife. Take a deep breath and dive into the magical world of lakes!

programme.title: Fighting for a Mate
programme.desc: Animals face daily battles to protect themselves and secure the resources they need to survive. Every battle is a trade-off between the risk to health and the prizes awarded to the victors. Each animal fights with a unique set of tools, from display structures and elaborate body language to claws, jaws and antlers. And few fights are as fuelled as those during breeding season the ultimate trophy for the brave fighter is, of course, a chance to pass on the fighting genes to the next generation.

programme.title: Masked Bandits
programme.desc: The masked bandits come with a reputation for trouble and mischief, and while they're certainly cunning and creative, they're also social, loyal and cuddly! From red pandas and badgers to coatis and, of course, raccoons – we'll cast any animal with a stripe across their eyes as pesky troublemakers. Take a moment to look past their robber masks and you'll find a remarkable set of creatures with stories you'll find nowhere else in the animal kingdom. It's time to lift the veil on the masked bandits!

programme.title: If There Was No Land On Earth
programme.desc: Embark on an immersive journey through the heart of the Indo-Pacific as we explore the breathtaking coral reef ecosystem, home to an array of vibrant fish species and magnificent manta rays. Let's unearth the secrets of a prehistoric cave nestled within this underwater wonderland and marvel at the stunning beauty of the shoals of fish that dance around us. The vibrant colors and intricate details of this marine paradise offer a mesmerizing glimpse into the world beneath the waves that captivate with the majesty and wonder of the coral reef, as we witness nature at its most spectacular.

programme.title: Little Cats

programme.title: Wild Warrior Encounters
programme.desc: In this episode the volunteers discover the community's role in conservation and give a hand with some of the building projects. Honey harvesting proves hair-raising for a number of volunteers, particularly Kristina, who has a bee sting phobia …. Who could blame her! A new addition bolsters the conservation efforts in the form of an amazing tracker dog called Merwe. This is a special Dutch Shepherd breed that has an incredible combination of a heightened sense of smell, speed and formidable teeth. It's always a privilege to be able to get close to black rhino and it can often be quite an emotional moment for some of the volunteers, as is the case with Jane who can't hold the tears back as she feeds Tafika for the last time.

programme.title: Wild Waters
programme.desc: From the highest mountain to the lowest valley, rivers and streams are freshwater highways, de-livering essential life blood to all kinds of wildlife. From some of the most iconic species like the otter and the trout, to the unfamiliar and elusive, like the delicate harvest mouse. Life on these freshwater freeways can be tough, and for many it's a constant battle just to stay alive. Take a break from the oceans and turn to the rivers and streams, home to the real wild waters of the nat-ural world.

programme.title: Dangerous Trails: Elephants in the Minefield
programme.desc: This film tells the story of peace and resettlement in Angola. After decades of civil War, the Elephants are returning via routes riddled with landmines. We show the challenge of both elephants and people reclaiming their land and living together.

programme.title: mareTV: Mexico's Caribbean Coast
programme.desc: The palm tree laden beaches on Mexico's Riviera Maya on the Yucatan peninsula are endless, and the turquoise sea with its gentle Caribbean surf is a warm 25 degrees during the mild winter in this part of the world. Between Cancún and Punta Allen, where once there was little more than bushland and a few sleepy fishing villages, vibrant life has evolved during the past three decades. Richard Sowa has lived on a floating island for the past 15 years: an island he built himself out of empty plastic bottles. The bon vivant him-self sees it as a "solution for our planet's refuse problem". Off Punta Allen, a village in the bay of Sian Ka'an, Mexican Mara Coral Ley and her cousin Kim, continue to catch lobsters by adhering to the traditional method and were awarded an "Eco seal for sustainable fishing" for their trouble. It is silent under water off Isla Mujeres and it is here that the artist Jason deCaires has constructed a sculpture park. Hundreds of lifesize figures form an artificial reef at a depth of 12 metres. Fish and plants complete his work of art. The master himself is convinced: "Mother Nature is the true artist".

programme.title: Hot Roads

programme.desc: The Sichuan Tibet Highway is the road of longing for many. It leads through fascinating landscapes and remote areas up to the Himalayan Mountains. We accompany truck driver Ren Taiping on his trip to the Tibetan capital city of Lhasa, encountering pilgrims, mountain bikers and nomads on this dangerous journey.

programme.title: Hot Roads

programme.desc: The racing cyclists of Burundi have a dangerous job. But it's a vital one for Burundi's economy. Bicycles are the main means of transportation in one of the smallest countries in Africa. Bananas, the staple food in Burundi, are transported from the markets to a banana beer brewing factory. We accompany Tharcien, a bike courier, on his exhausting cross country trip on the Burundi Highway.

programme.title: Hot Roads
programme.sub-title: The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads - S2 E05
programme.desc: The Canadian ice roads exist only for a few months in the winter when the ice is thick enough. The only time of the year when goods can be transported up to Northern Manitoba. We accompany the truckers Vlad and Hugh as well as the aboriginal Canadian Scott with his pick-up on their long journey to a village called God's Lake. A risky trip in icy temperatures, sometimes even below - 60 degrees Celcius. The men are in constant danger of getting stuck and need to forget everything they ever learnt about driving on a highway in order to arrive safely.

programme.title: Wild Prairie Man
programme.desc: Located in the Northern Great Plains of Canada, Grasslands National Park has been a 20 year odyssey for wildlife photographer James R. Page. For James, critters are more interesting than people and he shares some of his iconic images and experiences from this endangered ecosystem. We showcase the parks wilderness that is dominated by prairie light and dark sky, the wildlife, prairie dogs, mesmerizing landscapes, and bisons. We immerse ourselves in the wild habitat of Grasslands National Park for over a year capturing some never before scenes in the Wild Prairie. James R. Page's connection to the land and the wildlife provides an unforgettable journey into the heart of this endangered ecosystem, while Park experts help us understand its complexity.

programme.title: Countries People Adventures
programme.desc: In southeastern Iceland, Europe's largest glacier, the gigantic Vatnajökull, covers an area of around 9,000 square kilometers. Beneath it lie the world's most active and dangerous volcanoes. This extreme landscape is as dangerous as it is fascinating: glistening white glacier tongues, lagoons covered with icebergs, bizarre green lava mountains, snow-covered volcanic cones, solidified lava flows and imposing waterfalls overwhelm everyone who gets to see them. In 2008, Icelanders declared the glacier and adjacent areas a national park, the largest in Europe. In this documentary, the team meets people who live, work or do research here: a life with the dangers of fire and ice in the overwhelming landscape of Vatnajökull National Park.

programme.title: Wild Poland
programme.desc: Where in Europe are bisons still to be found in the wild? And where do probably more migratory birds breed than in any other European country? The flora and fauna of Poland are full of surprises: the South is dominated by the 2000m peaks of the Tatra, to the North-East the Biebrza river forms one of the largest swamp regions of Europe, a paradise for rare birds like the ruff. Masuria is the breeding-ground for thousands of white storks, more than anywhere else on Earth. The much shier and rarer black stork also finds refuge in the large expanses of forest that stretch to the Baltic Sea. In winter, an icy wind sweeps Eastern Poland and only those with a thick skin survive in the region bordering Belorus. The cold doesn't bother the bison. Thick coats protect these ancient cattle against the snow and icy wind, but lack of food in winter does present a problem. The bison here are among the last of their kind. Once upon a time, huge herds roamed most of the European continent, today the only bison in Central Europe living in the wild are located in Eastern Poland. Poland's hard winters are no problem for otter and beaver, whose extremely dense coats protect them against the cold and enable them to swim and dive in the icy water. Although both animals are water-dwellers, they're not rivals: beavers are vegetarians and in winter eat stores of leaves and bark. Otters are active hunters all year round and live on fish and crabs. As soon as spring arrives in Poland, the river Biebrza becomes a hive of activity: thousands of birds vie with each other to be heard as they use the vast area of swampland to rest and breed. White-winged black terns and black-necked grebes build their nests, then the mating season begins for the ruffs, with the males strutting their stuff for potential mates.

programme.title: Iceland
programme.desc: Majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, raging waterfalls, threatening fjords, mighty glaciers, endless lava fields – there is hardly another country in the world that offers as much impressive nature as Iceland, the remote island in the harsh North Sea. The nature in Iceland is immense! Here, the four elements of nature can be experienced as raw and as close-up as practically no other place on Earth. And nowhere on the northern hemisphere can the origin of life, can growth and decay be experienced as dramatically as here. Besides the impressive nature, we get to know the dramatic history of the Viking culture with its nature-influenced mythology and discuss the negative effects of excessive tourism.

programme.title: Iceland

programme.title: Seychelles
programme.desc: A vacation in the Seychelles - or even a wedding? This is the dream for many, especially Germans, who top the guest list at this island archipelago. But the paradise is under threat. We show the beauty of the island, with its rare animal species, happy wedding couples and white beaches. And yet: This is a paradise under threat, you can see the signs of climate change, with broken shorelines and bleached corals. Although the Seychelles has only 0.13 percent of Germany's land area, its new marine reserve is larger than the Federal Republic: A dream for the conservationists, who are supported by the Seychelles government.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While at Orange's general store to pick up a package, Berrykin Bloom chats with Orange about the pogostick he gave her to help her reach the upper shelves. She is very appreciative. He explains how the seeds were a better purchase because of all the benefits to the Berryworks but now he can no longer afford a vacation.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Plum decides to hold a dance recital at Strawberry's Café Cabaret stage and sends out a stack of invitations. Strawberry tells Plum she cannot hold the recital in the Café on her chosen day because the Café is booked.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: All of Berry Bitty City is gathered around to watch the last snowberrykin melt. As the last bit of snow forms a puddle, a cheer goes up, spring is here! It's now time for the annual BerryFest. But with Princess Berrykin out of town on business, who will be the BerryFest Princess and preside over the festival?! Everyone is abuzz with how to go about choosing the Princess and what her duties will be. Postmaster Bee declares the only fair way to go about it is to hold an election. Everyone agrees.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry opens her front door to a throng of Berrykins all cheering for the new BerryFest Princess. She is appreciative of their admiration but unsure of exactly what her duties entail. In response the Berrykins bombard her with her duties - major to miniscule. One Berrykin sums it up by telling her she's responsible for presiding over all the activities of the BerryFest to make it the best.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?

programme.title: New Girl in Town
programme.desc: When the World Petacular comes to Heartlake City and is almost ruined before it's even started, five feisty girls unite, despite their differences, using their creativity to save the day. Best friends Olivia, Andrea, Emma, Mia and Stephanie reside in HeartLake City but didn't know each other - that is until the World Petacular brought them together! On the eve of the biggest event Heartlake City hosts, disaster and chaos is abound. New-in-town Olivia is helping her veterinarian Aunt Sophie with her mobile clinic. But when she's put in charge of training a scruffy puppy named Scarlet, the puppy runs amuck, leaving a trail of destruction as she collides with Andrea, ruins Emma's banner and Stephanie's cakes, and finally spooks Mia's horse Bella who bucks Mia off and sprints away. The girls quickly unite, helping each-other to save the day and most importantly have fun along the way!

programme.title: Stephanie's Surprise Party
programme.desc: When Emma, Olivia, Andrea and Mia plan a surprise party for Stephanie's birthday, they soon discover that it's not easy keeping their plans secret from Stephanie who becomes suspicious when none of the girls have time to hang out. When Emma, Olivia, Andrea and Mia plan a surprise party for Stephanie's birthday, they discover that it's not easy keeping their plans a secret. As the girls choreograph a dance routine, magic show and search for the perfect present and cake, Stephanie becomes aware that her friends are avoiding her on her birthday and excluding her from their activities... Little does she know that her friends are secretly preparing a surprise pool party for her! Once the surprise is revealed Stephanie realises how much her friends care about her and the importance of friendship.

programme.title: Dolphin Cruise
programme.desc: Olivia, Stephanie, Andrea, Mia and Emma enter a science contest at school and win a trip on a luxury yacht but not everything goes as planned when they set out to sea. When Olivia, Stephanie, Andrea, Mia and Emma enter a school science contest and win a Dolphin sight-seeing trip, not everything goes to plan...As the girls set out to sea on a luxury yacht, misunderstandings and disagreements occur which become secondary when they discover a pod of dolphins in danger. The girls learn that they have to compromise and trust in each other if they are to save the dolphins and their trip out to sea...

programme.title: Rise Of The Snakes
programme.desc: The four Ninja are snapped out of their post-hero complacency when Lord Garmadon's young son Lloyd shows up and tries to pick up where his father left off. The Ninja dismiss him as a threat, but regret that choice after Lloyd wakes up the evil snake tribe. A prophecy is revealed that states a green ninja will ultimately defeat Lord Garmadon.

programme.title: Home
programme.desc: Back in training mode with the looming threat of Lloyd and the Hypnobrai, Zane wanders after a Falcon and lands himself in a heap of trouble. The rest of the Ninja leave the training dojo to help him and return to find that the snakes have burned it to the ground.

programme.title: Snakebit
programme.desc: Lloyd, having been kicked out of the Hynobrai snake tribe unlocks a second tribe – The Fangpyres – to help him regain control. The Ninja are busy setting up their new HQ that Zane discovered, but are called to duty when the Fangpyres attack the village where Jay's family lives.

programme.title: Never Trust A Snake
programme.desc: After the Fangpyres join forces with the Hypnobrai, Lloyd awakens Pythor – the last remaining snake of the Anacondrai tribe. Pythor lures Lloyd under his spell and steals a map from him that will show him where the remaining two snakes tribes dwell and Uncle Sensei saves Lloyd from doom.

programme.title: Country Girls
programme.desc: When the girls go to Mia's grandparents' ranch and Olivia accidentally knocks down the neighbor's barn, the girls promise to raise money to rebuild it and now have to learn to set aside their differences and work together to make good on their promise. Mia invites her friends to her grandparents' ranch for the weekend. But when Olivia accidentally knocks down a neighbor's barn with a tractor, the girls promise to raise the money to rebuild it themselves. Complicating matters, Mia and Stephanie turn out to like the same boy, Martin. They'll have to learn to set aside their differences and work together if they're going to raise enough money to make good on their promise.

programme.title: Emma's Dilemma
programme.desc: When Stephanie becomes obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in a float building contest and accidentally disregards Emma's ideas and design, Tanya convinces Emma to join her team to get revenge on Stephanie. When the girls enter a float-building contest, Emma is especially excited to share her design idea for the float. But no one is listening to her, especially Stephanie, who's become obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in the contest. Emma finally does find someone who appreciates her design… Tanya! Tanya convinces Emma to join her team to build the float design. But is Tanya just using Emma to get revenge on Stephanie?

programme.title: Friends of The Jungle
programme.desc: When Olivia's Aunt Sophie is getting married and the groom has gone missing in the jungle, the girls fly out to the jungle in secret to try to find him in time for the wedding. The girls are super excited to be planning a wedding for Olivia's Aunt Sophie. There's just one little problem: Olivia learns that the groom has gone missing in the jungle while working at an animal rescue station! Not wanting to worry her aunt, Olivia, Stephanie and Mia secretly fly to the jungle to try and find the groom, Henry, rescuing a few animals along the way. Too bad Emma and Andrea couldn't keep the secret back in Heartlake City. Now, Sophie, Emma and Andrea join the others in the jungle to try and find Henry before the rapidly approaching wedding date!

programme.title: Can Of Worms
programme.desc: Lloyd moves in and tries to make nice by helping out with chores, but he just gets in the way. Pythor has awoken the Vipoids and the Constrictaurs and an all out snake war has taken over Ninjago. The Ninja are not faring well, when a mysterious Samurai shows up and saves the day.

programme.title: Darkness Shall Rise
programme.desc: With the Devourer destroyed, Ninjago is saved and the rebuilding effort begins. Without their Golden Weapons, the Ninja are stripped of their elemental powers. And with their flying ship ‘The Destiny's Bounty' destroyed, the Ninja are forced to find a new home in the city. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon resurfaces and gains control of the Serpentine as well as transforms the Bounty's wreckage to become ‘The Black Bounty'. The Ninja will battle Scales and discover evil has begun to resurface in Ninjago, while Lord Garmadon will successfully forge the Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.Just as the rebuilding effort in Ninjago begins, the four ninjas come to realize that evil has started to resurface with Lord Garmadon forging the ninjas' lost Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.

programme.title: Pirates Vs. Ninja
programme.desc: When Garmadon by accident brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty – the ruthless Captain Soto and his Pirates - it is up to our ninjas to stop them from plundering Ninjago City. Sharing a tiny, one-bedroom apartment in the city, the Ninja take Lloyd to Grand Sensei Darreth's Mojo Dojo to begin training. There, they discover Lloyd has all four of their natural elemental abilities. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon discovers his Mega-Weapon can't destroy, only create what the user wishes. By accident, Garmadon brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty: Captain Soto and his Pirates, and they mutiny the ship. Answering the age-old question of who would win a fight between pirates and ninja, it's up to our ninja to stop Captain Soto and his men from plundering Ninjago City. In the end, Ninjago City is saved, the Pirates are arrested and Lord Garmadon escapes once again with their Black Bounty.

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: When our heroes are invited back to Darkly's Boarding School, they discover it's a trap set up by Lord Garmadon and his evil replica ninjas created by Garmadon's new Mega-Weapo. Realizing how to correctly wield the Mega-Weapon, Lord Garmadon creates evil replicas of the Ninja to face off with our heroes. Meanwhile, Lloyd and the Ninja are invited back the Darkly's Boarding School, only to discover it's a trap and now the bad kids have seized control of the school. With the Ninja trapped in the school with the faculty, things spiral out of control as the Evil Replica Ninja arrive. As an awesome battle takes place in the school halls, the Ninja manage to outsmart their evil versions, and warn Lord Garmadon they're ready for whatever else he throws at them.

programme.title: Fright Knight
programme.desc: Using the Book of Fear, Jestro calls forth Whipperella and uses her to trap the knights in the dark woods where they realize their darkest fears. Searching through the dark forests of the realm, Jestro finds “The Book of Fear.” It's pretty scary. But he feeds it to the book of Book of Monsters, and he uses it to call forth WHIPPERELLA, a monster that can induce fear. One-by-one she uses her “knighmarish” power on the knights and they experiences their own worst fears. Clay fears not living up to the Knights' Code. Lance fears being a nobody. Macy fears never being a knight and Axl fears having no food. Aaron must take the lead because he's fearless he does everything with reckless abandon. It's not until he leads the group out of the forest – as they fight off the Whipperella – that they we find out Aaron's true fear – the fear of peace and quiet and no more challenges or high energy escapades.

programme.title: Bas Cha Sudhi
programme.desc: I saw Kishan! So happy! you exclaim to Tea. Its retort, "Will Kishan be happy?" shatters your joy. Your perplexed "What now?" is met with Tea's pensive "Now, a meeting..." leaving you silent. The next step awaits in "A Visit."

programme.title: Bas Cha Sudhi
programme.desc: Why are you silent? Tea asks, cutting through your quiet. "Not saying no..." you mutter. Tea, eagerly, declares the sole solution: Kishan. Armed with this fresh perspective, you leave. What happens next in "Kishan"?

programme.title: Bas Cha Sudhi
programme.desc: Tea's sudden question, "Very happy today?" uncovers your concealed delight. It deduces love is the cause, playfully pressing, "Who is he? Dev or Kishan?" Your mixed reaction of laughter and worry sets the stage for "Tea and Love."

programme.desc: Koh Ae-rin, a mom that quit her job a long time ago, starts looking for a job to make a living when her husband suddenly passes away. While doing something no one asked her to at her new job, she finds out a secret of the Korean office of Cornerstone, an international military industrial complex. She gets involved with Kim Bon, the man next door that has been chasing after a huge conspiracy and involuntarily becomes a member of Kingsbag, a special organization within the National Intelligence Service(NIS). She grows rapidly within the world of intelligence, which had seemed like a totally different world to her, and shows great performance that even surprises the NIS agents.

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED

programme.desc: The new GLC is immediately recognisable as a member of the Mercedes-Benz SUV family. Standard equipment includes the AVANTGARDE exterior with Chrome package including chrome window surrounds and a new, chrome-look simulated underguard. This adds striking design features and enhances the unique proportions of the vehicle. One of the defining design highlights of the GLC is the redesigned front end, with headlamps that connect directly to the radiator grille to emphasise the vehicle's width, and the new radiator grille as part of the standard AVANTGARDE exterior, which now has a chrome surround and a sporty louvre in matt grey with chrome trim. The AMG Line has a radiator grille with Mercedes-Benz pattern. The body design is characterised by a full, spanned surface design enriched with precisely shaped edges in the sides. These emphasise the proportions, accentuate the muscular wheel arches and create a balance between elegance and off-road performance. Wheel arch liners in the vehicle colour are available from the AMG Line upwards for the first time. These accentuate the sportiness of the AMG Line, as optional equipment in conjunction with mixed tyres. Also available as an optional extra are easy-entry running boards and, from the AMG Line upwards, a Night package.

programme.title: The Mercedes EQS SUV Electric Art Line Driving Video
programme.desc: With the luxury saloon EQS and the sporty executive saloon EQE, Mercedes-Benz has entered a new, all-electric era in the upper market segments as well. The EQS SUV, the third model series with this architecture developed for electric vehicles, will soon follow. The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). The interior dimensions benefit from these generous SUV dimensions and from the advantages of the purpose design tailored to the electric platform. The second row of seats can be electrically adjusted as standard. Up to four golf bags fit in the boot. A third row of seats with two additional individual seats and extensive comfort features for all passengers is available as an option.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. Also included as standard: the ‘Front Assist' emergency braking function and, in the MPV, the ‘Lane Assist' lane-keeping assistant. With new software, new assistance functions are also making their way into the ID. family. Available as an option is ‘Travel Assist with swarm data', which facilitates partially automated driving across the entire speed range and, for the first time, assisted lane-changing on the motorway. Also new: the ‘Memory Function' for automated parking on a previously saved route.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.desc: The sixth generation Opel/Vauxhall Astra and third generation Peugeot 308 are both based on the Stellantis EMP2 platform and, unsurprisingly, score very similarly across all four areas of assessment.
